statement: Largest known training run >= 5e27 FLOP (Epoch AI; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Far from met. The largest publicly documented run at the timeline start was a Bloc A developer's 540B-parameter model at ~2.5e24 FLOP (April 2022) - about 2,000x below the threshold. The chat model launched 2022-11-30 disclosed no compute. Epoch's trend work put large-scale-model compute doubling at roughly 10 months.

items.summary: Compute analyst estimate: the final training run of a Bloc A developer's 540B-parameter model used ~2.56e24 FLOP (~64 days on 6144 TPU v4 chips), about 10x the 2020 GPT-3 run (3.1e23) and the largest known run.
items.detail: Lennart Heim, 'Estimating PaLM's training cost', 2022-04-05, updated 2022-06-05 (verified via web_extract this run); table: GPT-3 3.1e23, Gopher 6.3e23, Chinchilla 5.8e23, PaLM 2.5e24 FLOP.

items.summary: The developer's own paper for the 540B-parameter model reports training on 6144 TPU v4 chips across multiple pods and state-of-the-art few-shot results; primary source for the largest known run.
items.detail: Chowdhery et al., 'PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways', arXiv:2204.02311, v1 2022-04-05, v5 2022-10-05 (both pre-phase; verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: Epoch AI trend analysis: milestone-model training compute grew ~10-billion-fold since 2010 (doubling ~5-6 months overall); context for how far a 5e27 run lay beyond the 2022 frontier.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Compute trends across three eras of machine learning' (verified via web_extract this run; page now at epoch.ai/publications/compute-trends). At ~2.5e24 a 2,000x gap needs ~11 doublings.

items.summary: The frontier chat model released in the window was fine-tuned from a model series that finished training in early 2022; no training-compute figure was disclosed.
items.detail: OpenAI, 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30 (verified via web_extract this run).
